resources.string: The system action could not be opened. Open Health Connect or system settings manually, then return and check again.

Yealth reads only the health data types you choose, to display their original records, values, timestamps and sources. It does not write, delete, diagnose, score or upload health data. Records are held temporarily in memory while the app is visible and are cleared when it leaves the foreground. No health database, analytics, cloud sync or Internet permission is used. Older-data access is optional and requested separately. Revoke access at any time in Health Connect. This version supports the stable activity, sleep, vital signs, body measurement, nutrition and cycle-tracking data types listed in Browse. Access is requested by category. Exercise routes need separate session consent; Yealth does not request device location. Experimental mindfulness and clinical records are not requested.
